<div class="card-body">
'''Disarming Creature''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] ([[Immediate Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">腕を切断された生物</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">武器を持った自分のキャラクターが生物（スペース・スラッグを除く）と同じ位置にいる場合に使用する。任意の配備フェイズにその生物に配備する。生物は腕を切断され（「切断された腕」をつけられたのと同様とみなす）、凶暴性を求めるたびに、運命数を１枚引いてその値を引く。「コントロール」の影響を受けない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Disarming-Creature-PSA-151452836.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークはとっさに腕をなぎ払った。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Creature with its arm cut off.

'''Card text:'''
Use when one of your characters with a weapon is at the same location as a creature (except a Space Slug). Deploy on that creature during any deploy phase. The creature has its arm cut off (treated as if Severed Arm is on it) and, each time ferocity is calculated, draws one destiny and subtracts that amount. Not affected by Control.

'''Lore:'''
Luke struck the arm off in a split second.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says Luke struck the arm off; the English is a pun on 'out of arm's way'.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Disarming Creature]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
